name: The Swine Demon
source:
Liang's employer behind the scenes. According to Sui, he is a swine demon who has been engaging in spiritual practices for thousands of years in Luoyang and often eats girls.
[spoiler]In reality, he is just a human of great power and influence. He is based on a real Ming nobleman [url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Zhu_Changxun]Zhu Changxun[/url], Prince of Fu.[/spoiler]
